meta.author: Maunting Studios
meta.description: Discord-Bot-Umgebung mit Python 3.12. Unterstützt Datei-Uploads über den Datei-Tab oder automatisches Laden aus einem GitHub-Repository inklusive requirements.txt.

seedFiles.content:
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import zipfile

ROOT = Path('/data')
repo_url = os.environ.get('GIT_REPO_URL', '').strip()
branch = os.environ.get('GIT_BRANCH', 'main').strip() or 'main'
entry_file = os.environ.get('BOT_ENTRY_FILE', 'bot.py').strip() or 'bot.py'
custom_cmd = os.environ.get('START_COMMAND', '').strip()


def sync_github_repo():
    if not repo_url:
        return
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(repo_url)
    if parsed.scheme != 'https' or parsed.hostname not in ('github.com', 'www.github.com'):
        print('[MSM] Nur öffentliche GitHub-HTTPS-URLs werden unterstützt.', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    parts = [p for p in parsed.path.rstrip('/').removesuffix('.git').split('/') if p]
    if len(parts) < 2:
        print('[MSM] Ungültige Repository-URL.', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    marker = ROOT / '.msm_repo_state.json'
    desired = repo_url + '@' + branch
    if marker.is_file():
        try:
            if json.loads(marker.read_text(encoding='utf-8')).get('source') == desired:
                return
        except Exception:
            pass
    archive_url = (
        'https://github.com/'
        + urllib.parse.quote(parts[0])
        + '/'
        + urllib.parse.quote(parts[1])
        + '/archive/refs/heads/'
        + urllib.parse.quote(branch)
        + '.zip'
    )
    print('[MSM] Lade Repository ' + parts[0] + '/' + parts[1] + ' (' + branch + ') ...')
    zip_path = Path('/tmp/msm-py-bot.zip')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(archive_url, timeout=30) as resp:
        zip_path.write_bytes(resp.read())
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as zf:
        for member in zf.infolist():
            rel_parts = Path(member.filename).parts[1:]
            if not rel_parts:
                continue
            target = (ROOT / Path(*rel_parts)).resolve()
            if not target.is_relative_to(ROOT.resolve()):
                continue
            if member.is_dir():
                target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            else:
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with zf.open(member) as src, target.open('wb') as dst:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
    zip_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    marker.write_text(json.dumps(dict(source=desired)), encoding='utf-8')


sync_github_repo()

req_file = ROOT / 'requirements.txt'
deps_marker = ROOT / '.msm_pip_installed'
if req_file.is_file() and not deps_marker.exists():
    print('[MSM] Installiere Python-Abhängigkeiten aus requirements.txt ...')
    subprocess.check_call([
        sys.executable,
        '-m',
        'pip',
        'install',
        '--no-cache-dir',
        '--break-system-packages',
        '-r',
        str(req_file),
    ])
    deps_marker.write_text('ok', encoding='utf-8')

if custom_cmd:
    argv = shlex.split(custom_cmd)
    os.execvp(argv[0], argv)

target = (ROOT / entry_file).resolve()
if not target.is_relative_to(ROOT.resolve()) or not target.is_file():
    print('[MSM] Keine Bot-Dateien gefunden. Lade deinen Bot im Datei-Tab hoch oder hinterlege GIT_REPO_URL unter Start & Variablen.')
    sys.exit(1)

os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, str(target)])
